observations:
Torah #205 is a compact teaching with 6 bechina edges and 7 nodes. All nodes cohere into a single Package 1 (חֶסֶד וּגְבוּרָה וְהַדַּעַת). No independent bechina domain of 3+ concepts exists that is structurally separate from Package 1.

The three gap-concepts added in torah_205_additions.json (אַשְׁרֵי, מַשְׂכִּיל, הַלְלוּיָה) are all instances of the עשרה לשונות (which is already a node in Package 1) and belong within that same cluster — they do not form an independent new package.

The Torah's argument follows a tight two-stage structure:
  Stage 1 — The problem: the seed (טפה = חסד וגבורה from דעת) was captured by the klipa [evil pole, no bechina package]
  Stage 2 — The solution: תהלים = אל אלקים = חסד וגבורה can extract the seed [Package 1: good]
  Stage 2a — The structure of the solution: 10 chapters because דעת = 5 chesed + 5 gevura = 10; the 10 = 10 types of song = 10 languages of Psalms [Package 1: good]
  Stage 2b — Why each of the 10 works: each language (אשרי, משכיל, הללויה...) is the opposite of one aspect of the klipa [Package 1: good]

The EVIL MIRROR STRUCTURE in Torah #205:
The evil pole consists of: ליליות / קלפה / מְשַׁכֵּל (the destructive force) / קִלְקּוּל הָרְאוּת (corruption of sight) / יְלָלָה (howling). These are discussed in the source text as the counterforce to the tikkun. However, the dataset contains NO bechina edges for these evil-side nodes in Torah 205 — the existing 6 bechina edges are entirely on the positive/tikkun side. Therefore, no evil bechina package can be constructed from the dataset.

If the evil-side concepts were added to the dataset as bechina edges for Torah 205, they would form a second package:
  Hypothetical Evil Package: {קלפה, לילית, קלקול הראות, ילל/ילולא, משכל (Aramaic)}
  These are the exact negative counterparts to the positive package: sight-corruption mirrors אשרי (sight-restoration); howling mirrors הללויה (praise); the Aramaic meshakkel mirrors משכיל (understanding); and ליליות captures what דעת/חסד-גבורה generates. But since none of these have bechina edges in the dataset for Torah 205, no new package can be formally proposed at this time — this remains an opportunity for future data enrichment.
